lib.markdownDescription: Specify module name for import regular types.

typesRoot.markdownDescription: Root path for helper type definitions. See: https://github.com/vuejs/language-tools/pull/5872

strictCssModules.markdownDescription: Strict type checking of CSS modules.

inferComponentDollarEl.markdownDescription: Infer `$el` type on the component instance.

inferComponentDollarRefs.markdownDescription: Infer `$refs` type on the component instance.

inferTemplateDollarAttrs.markdownDescription: Infer `$attrs` type in the template and the return type of `useAttrs`.

inferTemplateDollarSlots.markdownDescription: Infer `$slots` type in the template and the return type of `useSlots`.

vapor.markdownDescription: Enable Vapor mode for all Vue SFCs.

fallthroughAttributes.markdownDescription: Enable to support typed fallthrough attributes. Please note that enabling may significantly slow down type checking.

resolveStyleClassNames.markdownDescription: Enable to apply completions and document links for CSS class names used in templates.

fallthroughComponentNames.markdownDescription: Component names that will be transparent when collecting single root child nodes and fallthrough attributes.

dataAttributes.markdownDescription: A glob matcher array that should always avoid recognized as HTML Attributes and Component props.

htmlAttributes.markdownDescription: A glob matcher array that should always be recognizing as HTML Attributes rather than Component props. Attribute name will never convert to camelize case.

optionsWrapper.markdownDescription: How to wrap option of `export default { ... }`. Default: `["(await import('vue')).defineComponent(", ")"]`.

name.markdownDescription: Name of the plugin module to be required.

plugins.markdownDescription: Plugins to be used in the SFC compiler.

vModelPropName.markdownDescription:
Prop that a `v-model` without an argument binds, keyed by tag, or `false` to bind none and only check the expression on its own. Tags match in any casing (`MyInput` and `my-input` are the same), and entries are merged over the built-in rules, then overridden per file by an SFC root comment such as `<!-- @vModelPropName { "my-input": false } -->`.

Built-in rules follow `@vue/compiler-dom`: `<textarea>`, `<select>` and text-like `<input>`s bind `value`; checkbox, radio, file and dynamic `:type` `<input>`s bind none; components bind `modelValue`. An entry of a native tag such as `textarea` does not apply to a component of the same name.

Custom elements need an entry, e.g. `{ "my-input": "value", "my-switch": "checked" }`: `v-model` then checks the expression against that prop and checks writing the prop's type back to it, instead of listening to `update:modelValue`.
